## Appearance

Laurence bears a remarkable resemblance to [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md), sharing the strange ocular quirk of having one hazel eye and one blue eye. He also presents as a black cat with white paws and a shiny black tail.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P39](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0039), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P12](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XXXII. TWO STUBBORN PEOPLE P17](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0017)_

## Personality

Laurence is known for his playful nature and fondness for pranks. Beneath his mischievous behavior, he is a genuinely pleasant person.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_
